description: Get collected store metadata for one extension, including users, ratings and version. Free without a key for basic metadata only; a key returns the full metadata record. Unknown IDs return not found, never trigger a crawl.

eid.description: 32-letter Chrome Web Store extension ID (a-p), not a URL, name or slug. Example: cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm.

name: extension_get
